PLAN "Travel Maintenance - Hotel Room"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary maintenance:
    name "Hold current strength and muscle during 2-week travel block"

  PHASE "Travel Maintenance" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Upper Body Bodyweight":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pike_push_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m

        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds

          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday rest "Active recovery"
      DAY Thursday training 30m "Upper Body Bodyweight":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m

          jump_rope 5m
